description: Configure a Lentra hub with the person's choices. Returns a plain-language summary, the Fixed Rent indication (needs country) and a link that opens lentrahub.com/configure with exactly this hub selected, to give to the person. The configuration is saved and the Lentra team is notified, as for the website configurator. Before calling, ask who the hub is for: the person's first and last name and email (and company). If they agree to share them with Lentra so the team can follow up, pass full_name, email and share_contact_confirmed: true; if they prefer not to, configure without them. Never guess or invent contact details. Returns configuration_id: pass it to request_proposal or book_call to attach it. Omitted choices take the configurator's defaults.

company.description: Company or property name, if the person gave it.

country.description: Country of the building (ISO code). Needed for the rent indication.

design.description: enclosed: built into a wall recess behind glass, the flagship. open: free-standing against any flat wall, no building work. Same price.

email.description: That person's email address, as they gave it.

finish.description: Hub finish: oak = Warm oak veneer, walnut = Walnut, white = Matte white, stone = Stone grey, charcoal = Deep charcoal.

full_name.description: First and last name of the person the hub is for, exactly as they gave it.

language.description: Language for the configurator link. Default en.

modules.description: Add-on modules beside the core hub, any combination: fridge = Beverage fridge (Chilled drinks, on demand), freezer = Ice-cream freezer (Frozen treats around the clock), tech = Electronics (Chargers, cables and accessories), wellness = Premium wellness (Recovery and self-care items), pet = Pet section (Treats, toys and pet essentials), baby = Baby section (Wipes, diapers and necessities).

note.description: Anything the Lentra team should know about the building or the request.

phone.description: Their phone number, only if they gave it.

share_contact_confirmed.description: true only if the person agreed to share their name and email with Lentra for this configuration. Required whenever full_name or email is passed.

size.description: s = Medium, 3 m, 12 compartments, best for 60–100 units. m = Large, 5 m, 20 compartments, best for 150+ units.

term.description: y1 = One year, then rolling. y2 = Two years, then rolling (pays 20% more rent for the whole time installed).

trim.description: Accent and trim, including the lit brand band: champagne = Champagne, brass = Brass, chrome = Chrome, black = Black anodized, acrylic = Backlit acrylic.

name: configure_hub
title: Configure a hub
